remarks: Discover the potential of this 20.3-acre parcel located in the center of Chautauqua County. This open property is ready for your next project or dream homestead. The land is clear of trees, offering a blank canvas for building, farming, or recreation. A gravel base has already been laid to start a driveway, giving you a convenient foundation to build upon. Several young apple trees were planted about 2 years ago, adding a touch of charm and future harvests to the landscape. Whether you’re looking to establish a country retreat, hobby farm, or simply invest in land with long-term potential, this property offers endless possibilities with a head start already in place.
